notes:
Account summary: Lumenridge (EU-headquartered fintech platform) evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for customer-facing chat + embeddings-based search. Big enterprise procurement: strict residency + zero public egress policy.

Key stakeholders: CTO (Marta Kovac), Head of Cloud Engineering (Rohit Mehra), InfoSec lead (Anja Sorensen), Procurement (Daniel Ruiz). AE: Sofia Patel. SE: Ethan Zhang. CSM planned post-go-live: Marisol Vega.

Security & network requirements (high priority):
- Must deploy in eu-west-1 (data residency). Logs and computed tokens cannot leave EU region.
- Private connectivity: InfoSec has mandated PrivateLink (interface endpoints) over VPC peering to avoid broad route table exposure. Quote: "No model traffic may traverse our peered route tables to other accounts" (Anja).
- Firewall rules: allow only outbound to Redwood PrivateLink ENIs; deny 0.0.0.0/0 egress except approved endpoints (S3 endpoints, KMS endpoints).
- Egress controls: all outbound must go via customer-managed NAT gateway with static egress IP ranges for allowlisting. Customer expects Redwood to publish a stable set of egress IPs for dedicated nodes or offer BYO-NAT.
- IP allowlists: procurement requires documented set of IP addresses for management plane + runtime; dynamic ranges are a blocker.
- KMS integration: BYOK via AWS KMS (customer-managed keys) with cross-account grant pattern; must support key rotation and furnish key policy template for legal review.
- Audit logging: export Redwood audit events + model request metadata to customer SIEM (via syslog/CloudWatch subscription); retention 7 years for auditing.

Current security review status:
- Completed: initial security questionnaire, SOC2 evidence review in progress, architecture diagram submitted (v1).
- In flight: pen-test sign-off (scheduled 2026-03-22), legal DPA redlines being negotiated.

Performance & SLOs:
- Latency target (chat): P95 token latency <= 200ms; must sustain 200 concurrent chat sessions during peak.
- Embeddings throughput: 4k embedding requests/hour initially, scale target 20k/hour after canary.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement prefers a hybrid of reserved dedicated capacity + burstable hosted fallback for seasonal peaks.

POC milestones & acceptance criteria:

- Perf: meet chat P95 and embedding throughput for 72-hour continuous run.

- Audit log volume and SIEM ingestion format — customer needs a sample log payload.
- Fallback policy: procurement wants explicit behavior if dedicated capacity is exhausted (automatic routed to hosted API vs fail closed).
